destinations.name: Rio de Janeiro
destinations.description: The most famous city in Brazil with Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain and the beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema.

destinations.name: Iguazu Falls
destinations.description: One of the largest waterfall systems in the world, with 275 falls on the border between Brazil and Argentina.

destinations.name: Salvador
destinations.description: The first capital of Brazil, famous for its colonial center Pelourinho, afro brazilian culture and carnival.

destinations.name: Fernando de Noronha
destinations.description: A volcanic archipelago with the best beaches in Brazil, crystal clear water and amazing diving spots.

destinations.name: Chapada Diamantina
destinations.description: A national park full of canyons, caves, natural pools and some of the highest waterfalls in the country.

destinations.name: Lencois Maranhenses
destinations.description: A unique desert landscape of white sand dunes filled with blue and green rain water lagoons.

destinations.name: Amazon - Manaus
destinations.description: The gateway to the Amazon rainforest, river cruises, jungle lodges and the meeting of the waters.

destinations.name: Bonito
destinations.description: The capital of ecotourism in Brazil with transparent rivers for snorkeling, caves and waterfalls.

destinations.name: Florianopolis
destinations.description: An island city with more than 40 beaches, sand dunes, good seafood and a strong surf culture.

destinations.name: Jericoacoara
destinations.description: A small fishing village between dunes and the sea, famous for its sunsets and wind sports.

destinations.name: Ouro Preto
destinations.description: A colonial gold mining town preserved as a UNESCO world heritage site, full of baroque churches.

destinations.name: Paraty
destinations.description: A colonial coastal town with cobblestone streets, green islands and boat trips in calm waters.

destinations.name: Pantanal
destinations.description: The largest wetland on the planet and the best place in Brazil to see wildlife like jaguars and giant otters.

destinations.name: Gramado
destinations.description: A mountain town with european style architecture, chocolate shops and a famous Christmas festival.

destinations.name: Sao Paulo
destinations.description: The biggest city in South America, with world class restaurants, museums, concerts and nightlife.

destinations.name: Recife and Olinda
destinations.description: Twin cities with colorful colonial houses, urban beaches and one of the most traditional carnivals in Brazil.
